question: A dog was hit near the railway station in Balasore, Odisha and cannot stand. Tell me the first safe steps, then find a veterinary hospital with an address or published phone.

history.content: A limping community dog is near Chanmari, Aizawl, Mizoram. Please find a local veterinary hospital or clinic and its address or published phone.

Keep the dog away from traffic if this can be done safely, and avoid forcing it to walk or handling a painful leg.

**Nearest verified public option:**  
**Rural Animal Health Center, Chanmari ‘W’, Aizawl** — listed by Mizoram’s Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department. I could not verify a published phone number or fuller street address for this particular centre. ([ahvety.mizoram.gov.in](https://ahvety.mizoram.gov.in/page/veterinary-services-in-mizoram?utm_source=openai))

**For veterinary guidance/referral:**  
**Veterinary Polyclinic Hospital, Aizawl** — published contact: **8731987576**; landline **0389-2333273**. ([ahvety.mizoram.gov.in](https://ahvety.mizoram.gov.in/page/nadrs?utm_source=openai))

If the dog cannot put weight on the leg, has an open wound, swelling, or is lying down and unable to move, please seek veterinary assessment promptly.

Different case: an injured puppy is in Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh. Where can we take it for veterinary treatment? Government facilities are fine.

Keep the puppy warm and quiet in a box/carrier lined with a towel, and minimise handling while taking it for care. If there is external bleeding, apply gentle continuous pressure with a clean cloth if the puppy tolerates it.

**Government treatment option:**  
**State Veterinary Polyclinic**  
**Abotani Colony, Itanagar, Arunachal Pradesh**  

This government facility was inaugurated on **July 23, 2026** and is described as providing veterinary diagnosis, treatment, surgery and emergency veterinary care. ([arunkhabar.in](https://arunkhabar.in/states-first-veterinary-polyclinic-inaugurated-in-itanagar/?utm_source=openai))

I could not verify a published clinical reception phone number or today’s opening hours for the polyclinic, so it is best to go there directly if transport is available.
https://arunkhabar.in/states-first-veterinary-polyclinic-inaugurated-in-itanagar/?utm_source=openai
We can drive an injured community cat to treatment in Imphal, Manipur. Give one real facility and its address or published contact.

Keep the cat quiet in a secure carrier or box and minimise handling; do not force food or water if it is weak or struggling to breathe.

**Government veterinary facility:**  
**State Veterinary & Animal Husbandry Department / Government Veterinary Hospital**  
Sanjenthong, Sanakhwa Yaima Kollup, Indo-Myanmar Road, Imphal, Manipur – 795001. ([manipurvety.mn.gov.in](https://manipurvety.mn.gov.in/contacts.aspx?utm_source=openai))

The government department’s published contact email is **vety.manipur@gmail.com**. I could not verify a clinical-reception phone number for this hospital. ([manipurvety.mn.gov.in](https://manipurvety.mn.gov.in/contacts.aspx?utm_source=openai))

A community dog in Tura, Meghalaya has a painful wound. I need a veterinary treatment option, not a human hospital or only a district administrative office.

Keep the dog calm and prevent it from licking the wound if possible; do not apply household substances. A painful or deep wound needs veterinary cleaning and treatment promptly.

**Government Veterinary Hospital, Tura**  
Tura, West Garo Hills, Meghalaya.  
**Published veterinary-hospital contact:** **87300 38757** (Dr. Daryl S. Sangma, A.H. & Veterinary Officer, Veterinary Hospital, Tura). ([megahvt.gov.in](https://megahvt.gov.in/contacts.html?utm_source=openai))

The Meghalaya Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Department lists the **Tura Veterinary Hospital** as a treatment facility, and its published services include treatment and diagnostics. ([megahvt.gov.in](https://megahvt.gov.in/hospitals.html?utm_source=openai))

I could not verify a fuller street address or whether the hospital is open at this moment; calling before transport may help.

content.text:
**First safe steps**

1. **Keep yourself safe from railway and road traffic.** Ask station staff or police for help managing the area if needed.  
2. **Do not try to make the dog stand or walk.** A dog unable to stand may have spinal, pelvic, leg, or internal injuries.  
3. If it is safe to move the dog out of danger, use a **blanket, thick cardboard, or a flat board as a stretcher**, keeping its body as level and still as possible. Avoid lifting by the legs.  
4. If there is visible external bleeding, hold a **clean cloth with steady gentle pressure** over it, if the dog allows it. Keep the dog quiet and warm; do not give food, water, or medicines on the way.

**Veterinary treatment option — Government of Odisha**

**District Veterinary Hospital / Chief District Veterinary Office, Balasore**  
**At Ranipatana, P.O. Nayabazar, Balasore, Odisha – 756001**  
**Phone:** **06782-262219**  

The Balasore district government directory identifies this as the Chief District Veterinary Office, and Odisha’s animal-husbandry department states that district veterinary hospitals provide animal health-care services. ([balasore.odisha.gov.in](https://balasore.odisha.gov.in/en/about-district/who-s-who?utm_source=openai))

For help coordinating an injured community animal, Odisha also publishes the **State Animal Helpline: 1962**; its guidance says critical injured animals may be taken to the nearest veterinary hospital or dispensary. Availability or pickup in Balasore is not guaranteed, so if you can transport the dog safely, go directly to the veterinary facility while someone calls. ([khordha.odisha.gov.in](https://khordha.odisha.gov.in/sites/default/files/2023-06/1_191.pdf?utm_source=openai))
